# Load config
```{r}
cfg <- read_yaml("/home/akollot/projects/CRC1588/dataset_integration/anglemania_benchmark/scripts/config_files/config_n_cells_test.yml")
```

# Load metrics
```{r}
# Extract relevant paths
metrics_path <- cfg$visualization$metrics_file
samplesheet_path <- cfg$samplesheet
outplot_bm <- cfg$visualization$outplot_dir_bm_visualization
# Ensure plot directories exist
if (!dir.exists(outplot_bm)) {
  dir.create(outplot_bm, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

# Load data
metrics <- read_tsv(metrics_path)
samplesheet <- read_tsv(samplesheet_path)

metrics <- metrics %>%
  left_join(samplesheet %>% select(-original_h5ad), by = join_by(sample == sample_name)) %>%
  mutate(
    groupCells = factor(groupCells),
    gene_selection = factor(gene_selection),
    integration_method = factor(integration_method)
  ) %>%
  janitor::clean_names()

View(metrics)
```

```{r}
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.7)
for (m in unique(metrics$integration_method)) {
  p <- metrics %>%
    filter(integration_method == m) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(group_cells), y = total, fill = gene_selection)) +
    geom_bar(width = 0.5, position = "dodge", stat = "identity") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("angl" = "#64487A", "hvg" = "grey")) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Number of Cells", y = "Integration Score", title = paste0(m, "_TotalScore_violin")) +
    ylim(0, 1) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      legend.position = c(0.8, 0.1)
    )
```

### Bio.conservation

```{r}
    for (j in unique(metrics$nbatch)) {
      p <- metrics %>%
        filter(ngroup == i, nbatch == j, integration_method == m) %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(de_fac_loc), y = bio_conservation)) +
        # geom_violin(aes(fill = gene_selection), position = dodge, width = 2)+

}
```

# Statistical Testing
## angl vs hvg: paired Wilcoxon test on integration scores

One-sample Wilcoxon test on per-sample deltas (angl − hvg).
H0: median Δ = 0 vs H1: median Δ > 0 (anglemania outperforms HVG).

Note: column names are snake_case after `janitor::clean_names()`.

```{r stat_overall}
diff_df <- metrics %>%
  filter(gene_selection %in% c("angl", "hvg")) %>%
  select(sample, integration_method, gene_selection, total, bio_conservation, batch_correction) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = gene_selection,
    values_from = c(total, bio_conservation, batch_correction)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_total           = total_angl            - total_hvg,
    delta_bio_conservation = bio_conservation_angl - bio_conservation_hvg,
    delta_batch_correction = batch_correction_angl - batch_correction_hvg
  )

stat_results <- diff_df %>%
  group_by(integration_method) %>%
  summarise(
    n                          = n(),
    median_delta_total         = median(delta_total,            na.rm = TRUE),
    p_total                    = wilcox.test(delta_total,            mu = 0, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    median_delta_bio           = median(delta_bio_conservation, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_bio                      = wilcox.test(delta_bio_conservation, mu = 0, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    median_delta_batch         = median(delta_batch_correction, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_batch                    = wilcox.test(delta_batch_correction, mu = 0, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_total_fdr = p.adjust(p_total, method = "BH"),
    p_bio_fdr   = p.adjust(p_bio,   method = "BH"),
    p_batch_fdr = p.adjust(p_batch, method = "BH")
  )

stat_results
```

```{r stat_by_ncells}
# Per cell count: does the angl advantage depend on dataset size?
stat_by_cells <- diff_df %>%
  left_join(
    metrics %>% filter(gene_selection == "angl") %>%
      distinct(sample, integration_method, group_cells),
    by = c("sample", "integration_method")
  ) %>%
  group_by(integration_method, group_cells) %>%
  summarise(
    n            = n(),
    median_delta = median(delta_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_value      = tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(delta_total, mu = 0, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_fdr = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    sig   = case_when(p_fdr < 0.001 ~ "***", p_fdr < 0.01 ~ "**",
                      p_fdr < 0.05  ~ "*",   TRUE ~ "ns")
  )

stat_by_cells
```

```{r stat_ncells_plot, fig.height=5}
p <- diff_df %>%
  left_join(
    metrics %>% filter(gene_selection == "angl") %>%
      distinct(sample, integration_method, group_cells),
    by = c("sample", "integration_method")
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(group_cells), y = delta_total, fill = integration_method)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("scvi" = "#4E79A7", "scanorama" = "#F28E2B")) +
  facet_wrap(~integration_method) +
  labs(
    title    = "Score difference: anglemania − HVG by cell count",
    subtitle = "Positive = anglemania outperforms HVG",
    x = "Cells per group", y = "Δ Total score (angl − hvg)", fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 14), legend.position = "none")
p
```
